data.name: Mica King
data.detailed_description:
Mica King is a top-down action-adventure with RPG elements. This packed and original single-player fantasy experience offers skill-based combat, different playstyles through character building, and a catchy story!

Your adventure takes place in a long lost fairy tale kingdom, a world of castles and palaces built into a landscape of mountains and canyons. On your quest for treasures and mighty items, you come into contact with the missing princess and are led onto an adventure that will determine both your fate as well as that of the kingdom itself...

Fight against strange creatures and an army of spirits and incantations controlled by an unknown force. Find allies, uncover hidden pathways, and overcome obstacles to unlock new areas and progress. In the end, it will be the adventurer's bravery and strength that might bring the kingdom to its former glory.

Key Features

  • Hand-crafted 3D fantasy world, split into several areas connected by portals in a Metroidvania-like structure

  • Build a custom player character and spend attribute points to focus on different weapons and equipment, enabling different playstyles from melee to ranged and arcane combat

  • Skill-based combat with unique enemies, fast-paced interactions with small enemy groups, and furious bosses

  • Complex and rewarding item and crafting system, where players can boost their character further by searching and collecting resources to upgrade weapons and gear, thereby enabling new abilities, as well as potions, throwables and other useful items

  • Original story with targeted 12-16 hours of gameplay

data.short_description: Mica King is an original top down action adventure game. Travel as an adventurer of variety skills to the once great and magical kingdom of Virrdale. Uncover the power of Mica and face the dark forces behind the bitter downfall of the king.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-4570 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 770 or equivalent with 3 GB or more VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5-4570 3.2 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
